# Browserless

Browserless is a service that provides headless browser automation, allowing users to run automations on their own sites with browser infrastructure.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/browserless/.

## Actions

- **Download file using Puppeteer script** (read-only): This tool allows downloading files that chrome has downloaded during the execution of puppeteer code.
- **Execute Custom Function**: A tool that allows executing custom puppeteer scripts via http requests.
- **Fetch HTML Content** (read-only): This tool fetches the complete html content of a webpage using browserless's content api.
- **Generate PDF from webpage** (read-only): This tool generates a pdf from a specified webpage using browserless's pdf generation api.
- **Scrape webpage content using CSS selectors** (read-only): A tool to extract structured content from a webpage by specifying css selectors.
- **Take Screenshot** (read-only): A tool that captures a screenshot of a webpage using browserless's screenshot api.
- **Unblock Protected Content** (read-only): This tool provides access to content from websites that implement bot protection mechanisms.
